retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the collapse of a quarry face and the road beside it at Borba on 19 November 2018, which killed five people. The atlas holds nothing it can be argued to have changed — no record of the response, the inquiry or the rules that followed — and the disasters it does hold, the fires of 2017, are wired to each other and to the reform they produced. A disaster with no recorded consequence has no honest edge.
